The '''Keeper's makers''' were [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] hailing from [[Keeper's World]]. They were a strictly non-violent people, and feared war. When a [[Unidentified war|galactic war]] entered their [[Keeper's World system/Legends|system]] they chose to flee their planet. To restore their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] after the war's devastation, they created [[The Keeper]], in the hopes that they might one day return. The Keeper created the androids [[Earth (droid)|Earth]], [[Fire (individual)|Fire]], [[Rain (droid)|Rain]], and [[Wind (android)|Wind]] in the image of this [[Species/Legends|species]].
